Player read thread captures self._proc when scheduled rather than receiving the process as argument; stop/seek can replace shared process before worker captures it. No race executed.
Reader process pipe cleanup/wait absent in _read_frames; stop terminates without wait. Preview reader does close/wait. Actual process leak not measured.
